answer: The river multiplier is published, charged in nebula, and mirror lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 19 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 2831 identities would post 3357 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
